remarks: Welcome to 168 Winfield Street, the location of this Ranch home nestled in the Sasqua Hills neighborhood of Norwalk, CT.. What a location for almost 3,000 SF of single level living with a Gunite 36'x18' heated, salt water, in-ground pool nestled on 1.26 acres. Check out the overhead pictures: Yes that's the yacht club, harbor, and the Long Island Sound literally just around the block! This home is being offered for the very first time by the original family who built this 1966 mid-century modern home. Yes, it needs to be updated to today's amenities and colors, but once you step in side, see the huge layout and the little bar where you can imagine Frank Sinatra and Sammy Davis Jr. sharing a drink, you will be overcome by the opportunity and possibilities. From the living room, the kitchen, formal dining room, family room with fireplace and the 4 seasons porch, you can't help but notice they are all generously sized rooms - we are talking almost 3,000 SF. Hardwood flooring throughout, currently carpeted. All of the expensive, overwhelming items have been handled, from a new 40 year roof in 2016 w/ transferable warranty to the entire home full of Andersen Renewal Wood thermo-pane windows. Exterior painted by Rhino Shield with transferrable warranty. New HVAC components and oil burner previously updated with 80 gallon hot water storage.
